units: <cite ref="Berakhot 2b:10">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>אי׳ שמשא וכ׳</he> when the sun is set, the day is gone (v. <cite ref="D00772"><he>דְּכִי</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>וכי תימא מכי אי׳ שמשא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עַרְבָא שמשא</he>) and if you say, when the sun sets, we call it night &c.; <cite ref="Megillah 20b:5">Meg. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>מכי ערבא וכ׳</he> (missing in Ms. M.).
